title: Quality drift capture — personal mini-sheet
content:
QUALITY DRIFT CAPTURE - MINI SHEET
Owner: Elena Morales (personal scratch)
Purpose: fast capture of examples where output quality changed after model/infra tweak. Single-page snapshot to seed canonical evals and quick syncs with applied-ml. Keep terse.

COLUMN DEFINITIONS:
- date: when I grabbed the example
- id: local short id (QDC-###)
- model: running model name/tag
- variant: quant/opt variant (e.g., 8bit, q4f16, bf16)
- prompt_short: 1-line paraphrase of prompt
- in_tok / out_tok: token counts
- p50 / p95: observed latency (ms) in lightweight harness (small sample)
- cost_call: rough $ per call (est)
- score: manual quality score 1..5 (1 bad -> 5 excellent)
- prev_score: last-known score (if available)
- delta: score - prev_score (signed)
- verdict: regression|improvement|no-change|needs-investigation
- notes: short bullet for root cause hypothesis
- action: what I will do next (eval ticket, rollback, escalate)

--- SHEET ROWS (latest first) ---
2026-03-04 | QDC-009 | redwood-2.1 | q4f16 | "explain-legal-term" | 34 / 95 | p50: 62 | p95: 178 | $0.0048 | score: 2 | prev: 4 | delta: -2 | regression | hallucinated non-existent statute, used confident tone | action: add to evaluation set, file ENG-4823 note, tag for model-owner

2026-02-26 | QDC-008 | redwood-2.0 | 8bit | "summarize-meeting" | 78 / 210 | p50: 84 | p95: 210 | $0.0062 | score: 3 | prev: 3 | delta: 0 | no-change | output lost a key action item (possible truncation pattern) | action: try longer context window, collect 3 more samples

2026-02-10 | QDC-007 | redwood-2.1 | bf16 | "product-compare table" | 55 / 240 | p50: 72 | p95: 190 | $0.0056 | score: 4 | prev: 5 | delta: -1 | regression | minor formatting shift (bulleting -> paragraph), acceptable but note trend | action: create soft-eval to measure formatting metrics

2026-01-29 | QDC-006 | redwood-1.9 | q8_approx | "convert-legal-to-plain" | 40 / 140 | p50: 58 | p95: 152 | $0.0039 | score: 1 | prev: 4 | delta: -3 | regression | truncated answer, abrupt stop; suspect kv-cache eviction under this quant path | action: repro w/ SLO harness, open infra ticket if consistent

2026-01-15 | QDC-005 | redwood-2.0 | 8bit | "compose-email-csr" | 30 / 88 | p50: 46 | p95: 132 | $0.0030 | score: 5 | prev: 5 | delta: 0 | no-change | clean output, baseline example for A/B

2026-01-08 | QDC-001 | redwood-1.3 | 8-bit | "short-summary" | 42 / 120 | p50: 48 | p95: 152 | $0.0024 | score: 2 | prev: 4 | delta: -2 | regression | hallucinated timeline; note for prompt engineering and eval set

QUICK OBSERVATIONS:
- Most recent regressions cluster on redwood-2.1 q4f16 and q8_approx (see QDC-009, QDC-006). Possible correlation with new kernel selection landed Feb 21 (PR#872).
- Latency/p95 spikes inconsistent; not enough samples here to attribute to infra vs model. Keep lightweight harness logs.
- Manual scoring drift is noisy: try 3-rater check for high-impact examples.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / HYPOTHESES:
- Is the timeline hallucination tied to prompt patterns with explicit dates? (QDC-001, QDC-009)
- Does the q8_approx variant drop tokens from tail more often due to reduced kv precision? (investigate with token-level diffs)
- Has the kernel selector chosen a fallback microkernel that favors throughput vs correctness? (cross-ref PR#872 and release notes)

NEXT STEPS (me):
- Add QDC-006 and QDC-009 to ad-hoc eval set (small-run, 100 examples each) by 2026-03-08.
- Run 3-rater manual grade for top 10 regressions, attach consensus comments.
- If repro confirmed, open ENG ticket with logs + token diffs + harness trace and ping Tom (infra) and Priya (model).
- Draft a short note to #applied-ml with 3 concrete examples and recommended rollback threshold.

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep this sheet lean: one-liners ok. When things look systemic, move to "shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/quality-evals" canonical doc.
- Filename: quality-drift-capture-elena.json (personal snapshot)

REFERENCES / QUICK LINKS:
- Kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/872
- Related Linear task: https://linear.app/REDW/issue/AI-145
- ENG incident reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4823

END OF SHEET
